description: Automerged PRs are merged by Renovate itself (platformAutomerge off) because GitHub's own auto-merge setting is off in these repos, and with squash because the rulesets allow only squash or merge and also require linear history.

copier.description: Template updates are the monthly manual copier sweep (handbook/cadences.md), not Renovate PRs. Generated repos record their source as gh:willzhu16/platform, which Renovate cannot look up, so leaving this on only adds a lookup warning to every dashboard.

packageRules.description: Batch minor/patch/pin/digest updates into one weekly PR (D-11 grouping value).

The non-major batch merges itself once every required check is green, like the lock file refresh. Majors still wait for a person. The checks are the review here; a red batch stays open for the weekly cadence.

Wait three days before proposing an npm or PyPI release. pnpm 11 already rejects any version under a day old (its minimumReleaseAge default), so a younger one only fails CI; the other two days give a malicious release time to be caught and pulled before automerge would ship it. Security fixes skip the wait: vulnerabilityAlerts sets minimumReleaseAge to null.

Give GitHub Actions the same three-day wait, along with the Node and Python versions setup-node and setup-python install. Renovate dates a tag by its GitHub release when that is later than the tag's own date, and a lookup on 2026-10-27 found a date for every pinned Action. A new release therefore waits the full three days, but a tag moved onto a backdated commit can look old, so this stops broken releases more surely than deliberate ones. The two images selftest.yml pins by digest alone stay out: Renovate has no date for them, and it never treats an undated update as old enough, so they would stop updating.

Hold pnpm below 12. pnpm 12 writes a new lockfile format that osv-scanner reads only a sliver of: on 2026-10-26 the pnpm 12 PRs scanned 15 packages where the current lockfile has 294 (athena) and 186 (canary-worker), so security / osv passed without checking dependencies. Lift once osv-scanner reads the new format.

Hold TypeScript below 7. Stryker's core still calls ts.parseConfigFileTextToJson, which the TypeScript 7 native compiler no longer exports: on 2026-10-26 mutation testing crashed under TypeScript 7.0.2 with Stryker 10.0.0 and with 10.1.1. athena and the cf-worker-app template gate on mutation score. Lift once a Stryker release runs under TypeScript 7.
Surface platform reusable-workflow major bumps on their own PR (D-18 migration = one line).
